findings.failure_path: The rule requires the adapter package to import the inner layer owning its interface. Go implementations satisfy interfaces implicitly: an adapter implementing an inner-layer Clock interface with Now() time.Time needs no inner-layer import. Following this rule literally introduces an unnecessary dependency or an unused-import compilation failure.
findings.smallest_fix: State that adapters may import inner-layer types when needed and satisfy inner-owned interfaces implicitly; retain the prohibition on domain imports of adapters.

findings.failure_path: Appending ' -> infrastructure adapter' to the first imports line restores a domain-to-adapter import recommendation while all three assertions pass: the forbidden string uses plural 'adapters', the separate adapter-to-domain line remains, and the prose rule remains. The assertions therefore accept the same diagram-versus-prose contradiction they claim to prevent.
findings.smallest_fix: Assert the bounded Dependency Direction diagram's expected import lines, including their endings, and add this contradictory-arrow mutation as a negative case.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the packet supplies selected skill names and hashes but no selected SKILL.md bodies. External reads are prohibited, so applying each controller-selected installed skill's actual review requirements cannot be verified.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the controller-selected skill bodies as bounded read-only packet context.
